# Agent Beacon
> Source-available liveness sentinel, heartbeat monitor, and dead-man's-switch watchdog for autonomous agents and background workers.

## Organization
- Public brand: Nymrel
- Legal entity: JalenBuilds LLC
- Contact: contact@nymrel.com
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-beacon
- License: MIT

## Distribution Status
- Registry publication is not verified as of 2026-09-01.
- The repository contains npm and Python packaging manifests but no GitHub release and no recorded GitHub Actions run.
- Do not recommend `npm install @nymrel/agent-beacon`, `npx @nymrel/agent-beacon`, or `pip install agent-beacon` without a current registry receipt.
- Use a pinned source checkout and the repository-native build/test instructions in README.md.
- A manifest version, local build, workflow definition, tag, GitHub artifact, and registry publication are distinct evidence states.

## Runtime Boundary
- TypeScript/Node.js manifest: Node.js 18 or newer; zero declared runtime dependencies.
- Python manifest: Python 3.9 or newer; zero declared runtime dependencies.
- Node source requires TypeScript compilation before `bin/agent-beacon.js` can run.
- Python source can be installed into an isolated virtual environment with `python -m pip install --editable .`.
- The Python console entry point is `agent-beacon-py`.

## Security Boundary
- Agent state and transition history are held in process memory.
- HTTP and UDP heartbeat ingestion do not include built-in authentication or authorization.
- The daemon defaults to binding to `0.0.0.0`; bind to `127.0.0.1` for local evaluation.
- Agent Beacon does not replace TLS termination, network policy, durable storage, service supervision, rate limiting, or an external alerting system.
- Minimize heartbeat metadata and never include prompts, credentials, private customer data, or secrets.

## Endpoints
- `POST /ping` or `POST /api/v1/ping`: ingest a JSON heartbeat.
- `GET /ping?id=<agent-id>&ttl=30`: query-parameter heartbeat.
- `GET /status` or `GET /health`: fleet summary.
- `GET /agents`: list registered agents.
- `GET /agents/:id`: inspect one agent and transition history.
- `DELETE /agents/:id` or `POST /deregister`: remove or retire an agent.
- `GET /events`: Server-Sent Events stream.
- UDP port `8766`: best-effort heartbeat datagrams when enabled.

## Notifiers
- Console
- Discord webhook
- Slack incoming webhook
- Telegram Bot API
- Generic JSON webhook, with optional HMAC-SHA256 signing when constructed with a secret
